raw/09-kanban-db/calibration-session-events.txt :: cm-59 :: cm-59|t_e1408991|author=manager|created_at=1789117222|2026-09-11T09:00:22Z|body=## Run 23 — found and fixed WHY this card kept flapping (unblocker bug), then re-blocked for the bench measurement

The agent-side deliverable was already done in run 20; what this run adds is the
root cause of the 4 re-dispatch cycles, because every one of them burned a full
50-iteration worker run on work no agent can perform.

### Root cause: `provider-exhaustion-recovery.py` unblocked this card every tick
That cron is supposed to skip human/operator-gated cards. Its guard read the
task **title**:

```python
if any(h in title.lower() for h in NON_RECOVERABLE_BLOCK_HINTS):  # titles never contain these
    continue
```

so the guard never fired. At 13:05 the card's last run was `reclaimed`
(crash-family) and the 6h window matched → auto-unblock → re-dispatch → burn 50
iterations → re-block. Repeat.

### Fix (pushed)
`felixfelix-bot/hermes-manager-scripts` @ **b55cfcb** — classify on the block
**reason + `tasks.block_kind`** via the shared `kanban_blocked_lib.classify`
(the same classifier behind daily-liaison-digest / capability-block-alert), with
a local marker fallback. Genuine D3 blocks stay recoverable (`circuit-breaker
(D3): …`, `block_kind` NULL) — verified, `host-driven-bench/t_561d8a41` is still
a candidate.

* `tests/test_provider_exhaustion_recovery.py` — 11 cases, incl. the exact
  t_e1408991 shape (`operator-action` reason + `kind=capability` + last run
  `reclaimed`). RED first (8 failures), then GREEN.
* Deterministic replay on a **copy** of the real meshcore board: with the run
  history restored to the 13:05 state, old logic → candidate, new logic → `[]`.
* Skill `kanban-stuck-task-triage` @ **59b8247** now documents the flap-loop
  diagnosis path.

### Remaining work — operator bench session (unchanged)
Runbook: `/home/c03rad0r/t_e1408991-bench-runbook.md`. Run `soak` → `edgescan`
→ `fit` → `cal <k> <T0>` → `ramp` + `hyst`, paste `fit`/`hyst` output here and
the row into `examples/passive_mapper/bench/RESULTS.md`. Kit is pushed on
`feat/passive-mapper` @ `d7ae93fa` (0 unpushed, clean tree).

### Unrelated observation (not touched)
`kanban_blocked_lib.py` + `tests/test_kanban_blocked_lib.py` are **untracked**
WIP from another session and `test_triage_card_is_surfaced` fails there (a
triage card whose reason carries a human marker buckets as NEEDS-FELIX before
the `status == 'triage'` branch). It still *surfaces*, so it is a mis-bucket, not
a silent park — flagging rather than editing someone else's uncommitted file.
